leray-ladder.thesis: the unstable branch family is a discrete-scaling ladder generated by the corner scale mode, accumulating at Leray scaling (alpha=-1/2)

faults.lens: freed-pin decisive run, both flanks measured
faults.why: Pre-registered fault rule met: (1) freed solve failed from BOTH branch seeds at deg24/eps1e-5 (A: TH0=1.79819132 stalls ||F||=2.35e-3, 9 takes/279s; B: TH0=2.39281792 stalls ||F||=2.17e-3) AND the pinned-TH ramp shows NO identity sign-crossing (h_id=+0.9942 at t=1.798 -> +0.9123 at t=2.10, slope -0.271, extrapolated crossing t~5.5 = 3x REF, vs identity-consistent 2.393). (2) Ground control: identity value is set by discretization, not corner data -- pinned ground family self-parallels the gI line (dcl/dt=+1.677 vs 2/WX_REF=+1.672, 99.7pct cancellation), so closing gI moved TH +0.1961 and alpha -9.73e-5 (G1 FAIL vs gates 6.5e-4/1e-6). (3) Branch root is grid-fragile: RE-HUNT DRY at (20,48,12) and (28,56,12) (||F|| floors 3.5e-3/4.1e-3) while alpha drifts -0.42173/-0.42555/-0.43084 AWAY from alpha_1=-0.4168236. Corner data (WX,THXX) are NOT family coordinates at these resolutions; the drifting root is adjudicated a discretization ghost, not a pinned shadow.

upheld on revisit: The fault stands as stated (corner data are not two free coordinates) but the mechanism is now identified: the family coordinate is the group INVARIANT t=THXX/WX^2, not the pair. Node 0 reopens if the t-scan finds a clean h_id minimum at t != t_ground

The group-invariant refinement of node 0 (t=THXX/WX^2 as the family coordinate) is REFUTED by measurement: |h_id| flat at ~2.2 across t in [1.17,1.55] with no minimum. Corner data, whether as a pair or as the group invariant, does not locate the branch. Node 0 stays faulted and the revisit lens must change: the defect is in the SEARCH (deflation at frozen alpha), not in the pinning

evidence: DeepMind's published empirical law lambda_n ~ 1/(1.4187n+1.0863)+1, with the exact change of variable alpha = -1/(1+lambda) verified on all four published alphas (residuals 4e-6 to 3e-3): (i) their asymptote lambda_inf=1 is alpha_inf=-1/2, the accumulation point node 3 predicted; (ii) their n=4 value alpha_4=-0.46557 vs node 3's -0.4649, agreeing to 6.7e-4. CAVEAT recorded as a refusal: same four data points, different functional form -- agreement of schemes, not independent measurement

nodes.text: SPECTRUM PREREQ: the scaling symmetry is a structural soft direction of J at every root (sigma_min 2.5e-6, 69pct aligned) -- it must be projected out before any resolvent/pseudospectrum, or it contaminates the smallest modes
nodes.link: if the symmetry axiom holds, Euler forces J.v=0 on covariant rows at any root -- MEASURED 2.8e-12
nodes.proof_condition: resolvent computed on the quotient shows the soft direction removed and sigma_min rising to the true operator scale
evidence: Prove-by MET, both halves. (1) The soft direction is removed: gate G1 ||Pi v_g||/||v_g|| = 3.88e-16 with Pi = I - QQ^T over {v_g,v_d}; deflating v_g alone raises sigma_min(J) 2.5356e-6 -> 2.2196e-1 (8.75e4x), both -> 4.6885e-1 (1.85e5x). (2) sigma_min rises to the true operator scale on the REALIZATION's own quotient: the grading is INADMISSIBLE as a perturbation (23.8 pct of its field norm sits on pinned nodes, dilation 37.8 pct), so the admissible space excludes it by construction; sigma_min(L) = 1/||R(0)|| = 3.970084e-3 vs sigma_min(J) = 2.5356e-6, a 1566x rise, with constraint residual ||Cg w||/||w|| = 2.4e-17. (3) The realization itself is now derived, not assumed: d_tau A = RO', d_tau B = RB', 0 = RP' verified symbolically to 5.83e-157, so E is a 0/1 diagonal selector of rank 4760/7670 and the DAE is Hessenberg index 2 with cond(G N) = 6.26. Gate G2 (dense reduced generator vs sparse bordered solve) agrees to 1.8e-13 at z=0, 1.5e-12 at z=0.3, 1.8e-12 at z=-0.8+0.4i.

Resolvent on the quotient shows the soft direction removed and sigma_min rising to the true operator scale: sigma_min(J_full)=2.5356e-06 -> sigma_min(L on ker(Cg))=3.9701e-03 (x1566) with the structural DAE projector alone; ||L||=1.1125e+03 so cond(L)=2.802e+05 against cond(J)=5.604e+10. Two routes agree to 3.603e-13 (gate G2). Resolvent on the imaginary axis is flat at 1/||R||=3.95e-03..4.07e-03 for y in [0,6], 4.5 orders above the arithmetic floor (refine rel 1e-10..1e-11).

INDEPENDENT REIMPLEMENTATION (scratchpad/spectrum.py, sparse-JPP-LU prolongation instead of the dense Pmap route) reproduces the node's prove-by and CORRECTS one number it rests on. Reproduced exactly: sigma_min(J) = 2.535593e-06 -> sigma_min(L|ker Cg) = 1/||R(0)|| = 3.970084e-03 (||R(0)|| = 2.518838e+02, 43 power iterations), rise x1565.7, with the STRUCTURAL DAE projector alone; ||Cg w||/||w|| = 3.9117e-17; Euler ||J v_g||_covariant = 2.814e-12; |cos(soft mode of J, v_g)| = 0.6886; deflation price at z=+0.50 = 1.955e-01. NEW, and the sharpest form of the do-not-deflate argument: the free-restricted grading shadow w1 = normalize(Pi v_g) IS admissible, and ||L w1||/||w1|| = 1.207936e+01 = 3043x sigma_min(L|ker Cg) = 1.086% of ||L||_2 = 1.112468e+03 -- it is an ordinary stiff direction of the GENERATOR, not a null. CORRECTION: this node's prior evidence cites 'two routes agree to 3.603e-13 (gate G2)'. That pairing (sparse bordered vs uncompressed dense solve at z=0) is not reproducible -- 8 seeds on the same (6,10,5)/Nb10 config give rel diff 5.255e-1 / 8.500e-1 / 1.086e+0, because Pi_c M is rank-2 singular there (sigma_min 9.5506e-16 vs ||L|| 5.149e+2). The gate's well-posed content survives and is re-measured: sparse-bordered vs ker(Cg)-compressed agree to 2.999e-11 across z in {0, 0.3, -0.8+0.4i, +0.5}, and ||R(z)|| by power iteration vs dense SVD to 2.029e-11. Realization validated end-to-end: QZ on (E,J) gives 376 finite / 346 infinite = (N-rank E) + m = 344+2, matching the compressed generator's spectrum to 3.734e-10.

Q3/Q4/Q5/Q6 measured on the corner-regularized quotient. THE CROSSING VERDICT: no eps-pseudospectrum reaches Re z > 0 for any eps below eps* = 3.93088947e-03 (root A, argmin y=+0.37833) / 3.084387e-03 (root B, argmin y=0); at the round-off floor n*eps_mach*||L|| = 1.175e-09 the pseudospectrum is confined to Re <= -1.5500, six orders of margin. The verdict is certified WITHOUT trusting an eigenvalue: Lyapunov L^T P + P L = -I solved by Bartels-Stewart, relative residual 4.849e-16 (A) and 4.879e-16 (B), Cholesky(P) SUCCEEDS at BOTH resolutions => Hurwitz. The RHP minimum is on the imaginary axis as Davies-Shargorodsky requires, confirmed empirically: coarse RHP map min on the Re=0 column 3.970121e-03 vs min over Re>0 5.310725e-01. Route agreement: blocked compression vs certified apply_M 3.374e-15; dense Schur sigma_min vs sparse bordered LU 7.751e-07 at production and 2.490e-04 at the extreme point z=-2+0.2i where sigma_min=2.19e-11; sparse descriptor-pencil Arnoldi vs dense Schur on the rightmost eigenvalue 1.28e-09 (A), 7.17e-09 (B).

ADJUDICATED (grading pass, no new computation): node 4's prove-by is MET and the measure agent's mint stands -- sigma_min(J) = 2.535593e-06 -> sigma_min(L|ker Cg) = 1/||R(0)|| = 3.970084e-03, x1565.7, with the STRUCTURAL DAE projector alone (ker Cg), reproduced independently at all three roots (x1565.7 / x1724.0 / x1529.1) and with ||Cg w||/||w|| = 3.9117e-17. The node's own premise is CORRECTED in the process: the grading did NOT need deflating -- it is inadmissible by construction (23.8 pct of its field norm on pinned nodes) and its free-restricted shadow w1 is an ordinary STIFF direction of the generator, ||L w1||/||w1|| = 1.207936e+01 = 3043x sigma_min(L) = 1.086 pct of ||L||; deflating it anyway moves ||R(+0.50)|| by 19.6/17.1/20.2 pct across the three roots, i.e. it changes the answer in the half plane the verdict lives in. GRADE BOUNDARY set by this adjudication: the prerequisite is WITNESSED; the downstream stability statement is WITNESSED only as a CONDITIONAL (Hurwitz on the corner-clamped class at these resolutions, Lyapunov rel residual 4.849e-16/4.879e-16/4.680e-16, Cholesky succeeds, eps* = 3.93e-3 vs round-off floor 1.175e-09); the unconditional form is REFUSED (see refusal unconditional_linear_stability_of_corner_profile, ratio 3.6e4). Node 4 therefore unblocks nodes 1-3 as a measurement instrument but supplies NO evidence for or against the ladder thesis itself.
